title: knowledge-lint: RULE_ORDER repeats the RuleId union across two files; the run mode is picked from three flags by precedence; writeMasterHashes takes three all-or-none optional parameters; splitReferences holds a parser mode in a number beside a boolean
evidence: Found splitting tools/knowledge-lint.ts (PR 1425). RULE_ORDER (tools/knowledge-lint.ts) lists the RuleId union (tools/knowledge-lint-rules.ts) less the two compare rules, so adding a rule edits both files; --init-state, --write-master-hashes and --dry-run pick the mode by precedence where one parsed union would do; writeMasterHashes(root, date, entries?, cfg?, allow?) uses the three optional parameters only when all are given, a hidden mode for test callers; splitReferences tracks level (-1, 0, n) beside a fence boolean
